---------------


**Job Title:** Senior GCP Engineer


**Experience:**

6\+ years of overall IT experience with strong hands\-on development expertise


We are looking for an experienced **Senior GCP Engineer** who is a hands\-on developer with deep expertise in Google Cloud Platform and modern data engineering practices. The role requires working onsite from Pleasanton and contributing to the design, development, deployment, and optimization of cloud\-based data solutions.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Design, develop, and maintain scalable solutions on **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**
* Work hands\-on with **BigQuery** for data warehousing and analytics use cases


* Develop and manage relational workloads using **AlloyDB**
* Build and maintain data transformation pipelines using **DBT**
* Orchestrate workflows using **Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow)**
* Implement infrastructure as code using **Terraform**
* Design, implement, and maintain **CI/CD pipelines** for data and cloud workloads


* Write efficient **SQL** queries for data modelling, transformation, and reporting


* Follow modern development practices including **vibe coding** and clean code standards


* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality cloud solutions

----------------------

* Advanced **SQL** skills


* Hands\-on experience with **BigQuery**
* Experience working with **AlloyDB**
* Strong experience in **DBT**
* Workflow orchestration using **Composer (Airflow)**

* Experience building and managing **CI/CD pipelines**
* Exposure to **vibe coding** and modern development practices

----------------------


* Must be a **hands\-on developer** (no pure coordination roles)


* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills


* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities

title: Embedded Engineer
description:
**Location:** Noida  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**About the Role**

We are looking for an **Embedded Software Engineer** who has hands\-on experience in embedded systems and microcontroller\-based product development. The candidate will be responsible for developing, testing, debugging, and maintaining embedded software for our devices.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain **embedded firmware/software** for microcontroller\-based systems.
* Work with **ESP32** and other microcontrollers for embedded product development.
* Develop and integrate communication protocols such as **MQTT** for device\-to\-server/cloud communication.
* Work with **RTOS** and implement multitasking, task scheduling, synchronization, and resource management.
* Develop firmware for **IoT\-connected devices** and ensure reliable communication between hardware and software.
* Interface and work with various **sensors, modules, displays, and peripheral devices**.
* Debug hardware\-software integration issues and troubleshoot firmware\-related problems.
* Perform firmware testing, debugging, validation, and optimization.
* Work closely with the **hardware and electronics team** during product development and testing.
* Participate in product integration, field testing, and troubleshooting when required.
* Maintain technical documentation, firmware versions, test reports, and development records.
* Identify and resolve performance, connectivity, and reliability issues in embedded systems.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of **Embedded C/C\+\+**.
* Hands\-on experience with **ESP32** or similar microcontrollers.
* Working knowledge of **RTOS** such as FreeRTOS or similar.
* Experience with **MQTT** and other communication protocols.
* Understanding of **UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, ADC, PWM**, and other common embedded interfaces.
* Knowledge of debugging tools and techniques for embedded systems.
* Understanding of basic electronics and **hardware\-software integration**.
* Experience with Git or other version\-control systems is preferred.
* Good problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in **IoT or connected\-device development**.
* Experience working with sensors and real\-time data acquisition.
* Experience with Wi\-Fi/Bluetooth connectivity.
* Experience in developing firmware for commercial/industrial products.
* Exposure to device testing, firmware updates, and field troubleshooting.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Have you worked with RTOS? If yes, which one?
* If you are selected, how soon would you be able to join us in Noida?
* Have you worked with MQTT before?
* Have you worked with ESP32 or similar microcontrollers?

Experience:

* total work: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

description:

 At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change, we lead it. AI and digital innovation are transforming the way businesses work, and we’re at the forefront of it. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry\-first accelerator, exemplifies how we scale advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. Whether tackling complex challenges through large\-scale models or agentic AI, our breakthrough solutions tackle companies’ most complex challenges.  

  

If you thrive in a fast\-moving, innovation\-driven environment, love building and deploying cutting\-edge AI solutions, and want to push the boundaries of what’s possible, this is your moment.  

  

Genpact (NYSE: G) is an agentic and advanced technology solutions company. We leverage process intelligence and artificial intelligence to deliver measurable outcomes. With a strong partner ecosystem and decades of client trust, we provide innovative solutions that transform how businesses run. Powered by a team with an active learning mindset and client centricity at its core, we deliver lasting value for the world’s leading enterprises.  

 Get to know us at genpact.com and on LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and Facebook.

**Job Description**


Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain high\-performance real\-time data processing applications using Apache Flink.
* Develop in\-flight transformation logic leveraging Apache Flink, Kafka Streams, KSQLDB, and Kafka Single Message Transforms (SMTs).
* Build and maintain scalable mapping frameworks for transforming source system data into harmonized enterprise data models.
* Implement complex event processing, enrichment, filtering, aggregation, and windowing logic for streaming workloads.
* Optimize streaming pipeline performance, ensuring low latency, high throughput, and efficient resource utilization.
* Design solutions to handle late\-arriving and out\-of\-order events using event\-time processing, watermarks, checkpointing, and state management.
* Integrate streaming applications with Kafka, Schema Registry, APIs, and downstream analytical platforms.
* Implement robust error handling, retry mechanisms, dead\-letter queues (DLQ), and monitoring for streaming applications.
* Collaborate with Solution Architects, Data Architects, API teams, and business stakeholders to define transformation rules and streaming integration patterns.
* Develop automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for streaming applications.
* Monitor production streaming jobs and troubleshoot performance, scalability, and reliability issues.


Required Skills \& Experience

* 6–10\+ years of experience in Data Engineering with strong expertise in real\-time streaming solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with Apache Flink for enterprise\-scale stream processing.
* Strong knowledge of Apache Kafka, Kafka Streams, KSQLDB, Kafka Connect, and Single Message Transforms (SMTs).
* Experience designing event\-driven data architectures and real\-time data integration pipelines.
* Strong understanding of event\-time processing, watermarks, windowing, checkpointing, stateful stream processing, and fault tolerance.
* Experience developing data transformation and harmonization frameworks for enterprise data platforms.
* Proficiency in Java and/or Scala; Python knowledge is desirable.
* Experience with Avro, Protobuf, JSON, Schema Registry, and serialization techniques.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with large\-scale structured and semi\-structured datasets.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP is preferred.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, and monitoring tools is an advantage.


Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Confluent Platform and enterprise Kafka deployments.
* Exposure to modern data lakehouse platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or Delta Lake.
* Knowledge of CDC patterns, API integration, and enterprise integration architectures.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder communication skills.

title: IoT Engineer
description:
We are looking for a skilled and motivated **IoT Engineer** to design, develop, and maintain IoT solutions, including connected devices, sensors, embedded systems, and PCB\-based hardware. The candidate will work on hardware design, firmware development, and cloud integration to build reliable and scalable IoT applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and implement IoT solutions using sensors, microcontrollers, and connected devices.
* **Design and develop PCBs for IoT devices, including schematic capture, component selection, and PCB layout.**
* **Create and modify PCB designs using tools such as Altium Designer, KiCad, Eagle, or similar software.**
* **Perform PCB routing, component placement, and design optimization for signal integrity, power management, and manufacturability.**
* **Prepare Gerber files, BOMs, and other manufacturing documentation for PCB fabrication and assembly.**
* Develop and integrate firmware for IoT devices using platforms such as ESP32, Arduino, or Raspberry Pi.
* Work with communication protocols such as MQTT, HTTP, BLE, Wi\-Fi, and LoRaWAN.
* Develop and integrate APIs for communication between IoT devices and cloud platforms.
* Configure and manage IoT platforms, databases, and cloud services.
* Collect, process, and analyze data received from connected devices.
* Perform hardware testing, PCB debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Collaborate with software, hardware, and product development teams.
* Ensure IoT systems are secure, reliable, and scalable.
* Prepare technical documentation, system designs, and project reports.
* Stay updated with emerging IoT and embedded hardware technologies.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of IoT architecture and connected\-device technologies.
* **Experience in PCB design, schematic capture, and PCB layout.**
* **Proficiency in PCB design tools such as Altium Designer, KiCad, Eagle, or similar.**
* **Understanding of electronic components, circuit design, power supplies, and signal routing.**
* Experience with embedded systems and microcontrollers.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as **C, C\+\+, Python, or JavaScript**.
* Understanding of communication protocols such as **MQTT, HTTP, and REST APIs**.
* Knowledge of databases such as **MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB**.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as **AWS IoT, Azure IoT, or Google Cloud**.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Good communication and teamwork abilities.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
